lines.text: Anthropic went public, and hit two point one trillion dollars on day one.
IPO price, eighty-three dollars. First trade, one eleven fifty.
But by the close, ninety-seven seventeen.
Still up 17% for IPO buyers. Not for those who bought the open.
First-half revenue, sixteen point three billion dollars.
Analysts' warning: day-one buyers of hot IPOs have often lagged the market.
Follow for more quiet business breakdowns.
